leverHints.name: TERRA_NULLIUS_RUSH.priority
leverHints.hint: Base priority is 55; bump if we never make it above 10% map share.

leverHints.name: EASY_NATION_GRAB.priority
leverHints.hint: Raise if we let weak Nations sit on our border for >60s without rolling them.

leverHints.name: THREAT_CROWN_THRESHOLD
leverHints.hint: Lower (0.18?) to react to the crown earlier; risk of thrashing when nations yo-yo near the line.

leverHints.name: ATOM_GOLD_THRESHOLD
leverHints.hint: If we never save this much gold, check whether BuildPriority starves silos/cities.

leverHints.name: STEALTH_MAX_ATTACKS_PER_SEC
leverHints.hint: If intentsBlocked / intentsSent > 0.3, relaxing this recovers lost tempo.

leverHints.name: BuildPriority
leverHints.hint: City → Factory → Port → DefensePost → MissileSilo → SAMLauncher. Re-order if DPs eat too much gold early.

leverHints.name: RL_OUTCOME_WINDOW_TICKS
leverHints.hint: 30 ticks = 3s. Lengthen if attack outcomes consistently look null (clashes resolve slower than 3s).

leverHints.name: STEALTH_SPAWN_THINK_MS
leverHints.hint: 8s 'think' before spawning. Shorten if we ever spawn after opponents grabbed the best land.
